settings.name: Travers Steel
settings.address: 2 Downpatrick Street, Rathfriland, Newry, County Down, BT34 5DG
settings.about: Travers Steel is a family-run business based in Rathfriland, County Down. Its published website describes over 25 years of experience in designing, manufacturing and installing steelwork for domestic and commercial clients.

services.title: Staircases
services.short: Staircases for domestic and commercial requirements.
services.body: Travers Steel lists staircases among its steelwork services. The team offers design, manufacture, delivery and installation, with quotations tailored to the requirements of each customer. Discuss your dimensions, intended use and project details to arrange a free quotation.
